negative_reviews.author: Noth
negative_reviews.text:
Unfortunately, Ramen Ichiramen no longer offers a regular, non-halal Steak Tataki Ramen. Previously, customers could choose between halal and non-halal beef, but now the website states that all beef used in their ramen is halal, leaving customers with no alternative.

I believe this is unfair to customers who, for personal or religious reasons, do not wish to consume halal meat. As a Christian, I do not believe I should be expected to accept a religiously prepared product when I previously had the option to choose otherwise.

I fully respect the right of Muslim customers to choose halal food. However, I believe the same consideration should be given to customers who prefer non-halal meat. Previously, both options were available, but now only halal beef is offered, meaning that customers who do not want halal meat have lost their choice.

In my opinion, a restaurant should respect the different dietary preferences and beliefs of all its customers rather than remove an option that was previously available.

Unfortunately, this change has left me disappointed. I would like to see Ramen Ichiramen reintroduce the non-halal beef option for its Steak Tataki Ramen.

One star due to the loss of choice and the lack of consideration for customers who do not wish to eat halal meat.
